description: This is a test suite for the Volcengine embedding integration in the litellm library, following the LiteLLM testing patterns. It primarily contains unit tests that mock API responses, verify embedding outputs, and check error handling specific to the volcengine embedding model.

classes.name: TestVolcEngineEmbedding
classes.description: Test class extending BaseLLMEmbeddingTest to test the Volcengine embedding integration with various scenarios.

methods.name: litellm.LlmProviders get_custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the specific LlmProviders enum for VOLCENGINE.

methods.name: dict get_base_embedding_call_args(self)
methods.description: Provides base arguments for calls to the embedding function.

methods.name: test_basic_embedding(self, sync_mode)
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the basic embedding functionality with mock responses for both sync and async modes.

methods.name: test_volcengine_embedding_with_encoding_formats()
methods.description: Tests embedding with different encoding formats (float, base64, default).

methods.name: test_volcengine_embedding_with_user_parameter()
methods.description: Verifies that the user parameter is correctly passed and handled.

methods.name: test_volcengine_embedding_error_scenarios()
methods.description: Ensures proper error handling for invalid model names and encoding formats.

methods.name: test_volcengine_embedding_with_multiple_inputs()
methods.description: Tests the embedding function with various input list scenarios, including different lengths, unicode, and batch processing.

methods.name: test_volcengine_embedding_with_encoding_formats
methods.description: Checks responses when using different encoding formats like base64 and default float.
